name: REALM
overview: Realm is an “Actual Play” Dungeons & Dragons series, bringing together professional artists to play through a fantastical adventure full of danger and intrigue. While this story begins firmly within the High Fantasy category, this tale promises to bend this genre to its maximum capability. All is not as it seems in The Realm, and our players will have to uncover the truth of their world if they hope to save it…or escape it.
